WITH rating_counts AS (
  SELECT f.rating, COUNT(i.inventory_id) AS copies
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.rating
),
stats AS (
  SELECT AVG(copies) AS avg_copies
  FROM rating_counts
)
SELECT 
  SUM(CASE WHEN rc.copies > s.avg_copies THEN rc.copies ELSE 0 END) AS total_copies_above_avg,
  AVG(CASE WHEN rc.copies > s.avg_copies THEN rc.copies - s.avg_copies ELSE NULL END) AS avg_excess
FROM rating_counts rc, stats s
